lines.text: Control, this is Post Three. Someone is running in the corridor.
lines.beat_before: hook: torch POV down a vaulted corridor; a grey figure runs across the far end

lines.text: The Castle of Good Hope. Cape Town. The oldest colonial building in South Africa.
lines.beat_before: she is gone; cut to the castle from above at night, the pentagon of bastions, the mountain

lines.text: The guards before me said, you'll hear footsteps. And when you stop... they take two more.
lines.beat_before: a window lights by itself; cut to the courtyard, walking

lines.text: Seventeen twenty-nine. Governor van Noodt sentenced seven soldiers to hang. One of them, the story goes, cursed him from the gallows.
lines.beat_before: he stops; two more steps behind him; the torch swings round: a door across the yard closing

lines.text: The same day, the governor was found dead, in his chair. History says it was his heart.
lines.beat_before: the governor's room: the desk, the ledger, the chair pushed in

lines.text: Guards have reported a tall man, leaning over the battlements.
lines.beat_before: the chair slides back from the desk by itself; cut to the ramparts in the wind

lines.text: And a woman in grey, running through the corridors.
lines.beat_before: a tall figure leaning over the battlements ahead; the torch flickers; gone; cut to the corridor

lines.text: When they dug here, they found the remains of a woman. No one knows who she was.
Control, Post Three. Dungeon's clear. I'm coming up.
lines.beat_before: she runs at him from the end; the torch dies; she passes; cut to the dungeon steps
